narrative.overview:
This is a keepsake, not a dashboard. The system renders trust as a physical thing — a glass jar on warm paper, filling with amber marbles — and every visual decision serves that metaphor: sunlit neutrals, ink type, one glowing accent, surfaces that layer like paper rather than float like panels.

Amber leads emotionally but never decorates chrome: it fills the jar, the progress bar, and every added marble, while ink and pine carry the actions. Seven muted tag hues share equal weight wherever a tag is referenced, and lightness never ranks.
keyCharacteristics: Keepsake over dashboard: one jar per screen, generous whitespace, no dense data grids.
Amber belongs to the marbles: the accent marks trust itself, never buttons or borders.
Soft and tactile: generous radii (14–18px, pill chips), one soft card shadow, pressed-state dimming.
Layered paper: depth from tonal neutrals and hairlines, not elevation.
Honest record: removals and empty states are designed first-class, never hidden.

rules.name: The Amber Belongs to the Marbles Rule
rules.body: Amber (#E8A33D) marks marbles and their progress — jar fill, progress fill, added dots — and nothing else.

rules.name: The Tags Share No Rank Rule
rules.body: The seven tag hues are categorical: similar weight, stable per tag, shared everywhere a tag is referenced. They never encode importance — lightness never ranks — and they never replace words.

rules.name: The Weight-Carries-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: No custom fonts, no colored type for emphasis, no size below 12px.

rules.name: The Paper-Stack Rule
rules.body: Depth is tonal layering, not elevation. Nothing besides the person card lifts.

rules.name: The Soft Geometry Rule
rules.body: Everything a finger touches is round — 14px controls, 18px containers, pill selections.

rules.name: The Vessel Has Weight Rule
rules.body: The jar is drawn, not decorated: 3px ink walls, 5px rim, cream glass, amber fill and shine inside it.

dos: Keep amber on marbles and progress; ink/pine on actions.
Use the Sand steps in order for borders, fields, cards, dividers, tracks.
Set secondary text in cocoa/stone, never below 12px.
Give every touchable the pressed dim (opacity 0.75).
Write empty states as invitations, never blank space.
Keep removals visible with the ○ marker.
donts: Don't put amber on buttons, borders, or decoration.
Don't add shadows beyond the person card.
Don't introduce a custom font, accent colors beyond the seven shared tag hues, or template blue (#2f95dc).
Don't invent testimonials, counts, or claims.
Don't sharpen corners below 14px on touchables or replace the jar vessel with a chart.
